text.en: Inserting Sec. 8-A and Sec. 8-B in the 1978 Election Code. New sections to be designated as

A and Sec. 8-B shall be inserted between Sections 8 and 9 of the 1978 Election Code to read as
"Sec. 8-A. SUBSTITUTION OF A CANDIDATE WHO DIES, FAILS TO QUALIFY OR IS
INCAPACITATED BEFORE PROCLAMATION THE VOTES OBTAINED BY A CANDIDATE WHO
DIES, FAILS TO QUALIFY OR IS INCAPACITATED AFTER THE DAY OF THE ELECTION BUT
BEFORE PROCLAMATION OF THE WINNERS IN THE ELECTION CODE FOR MEMBERS OF THE
INTERIM BATASANG PAMBANSA SHALL CONTINUE TO BE CANVASSED BY THE REGIONAL
BOARD OF CANVASSERS AND IF AFTER SAID CANVASS, THE CANDIDATE WHO DIED, FAILED
TO QUALIFY OR WAS INCAPACITATED IS ONE OF THE WINNERS, THE SEAT FOR WHICH HE
WAS A CANDIDATE SHALL BE FILLED IN THE FOLLOWING MANNER:
(1) IN THE CASE OF A CANDIDATE WHO WAS OFFICIALLY NOMINATED BY A POLITICAL
PARTY OR GROUP, THE INTERIM BATASANG PAMBANSA SHALL APPOINT THE
REPLACEMENT UPON NOMINATION OF THE POLITICAL PARTY OR GROUP WHICH
NOMINATED THE DECEASED CANDIDATE.
(2) IN THE CASE OF A CANDIDATE WHO DID NOT BELONG TO THE OFFICIAL TICKET OF ANY
POLITICAL PARTY OR GROUP, THE INCUMBENT PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES SHALL
NOMINATE AND WITH THE CONSENT OF THE INTERIM BATASANG PAMBANSA, APPOINT THE
REPLACEMENT OF THE DECEASED.
Sec. 8-B. REPLACEMENT OF A MEMBER-ELECT WHO DIES, FAILS TO QUALIFY OR IS
INCAPACITATED BEFORE OATH-TAKING. THE PROVISIONS OF THE PRECEDING SECTION
SHALL APPLY IN THE CASE OF A MEMBER-ELECT WHO DIES, FAILS TO QUALIFY OR IS
INCAPACITATED BEFORE ASSUMPTION OF OFFICE."
Section 2. Effectivity. This decree shall take effect immediately.

DONE in the City of Manila, this 10th day of April, in the Year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
